mapper.sql: id, report_id, version, report_content, change_reason, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO career_report_history (id, report_id, version, report_content, change_reason, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{reportId}, #{version}, #{reportContent}, #{changeReason}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM career_report_history WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT FROM career_report_history WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND version = #{version} LIMIT 1
